knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Consumables used on the job change with each job, so they are variable.
A price needs its GST position and its exclusions and validity stated.
Break-even jobs are fixed monthly costs divided by contribution per job (price excluding GST minus variable cost).

practicalCriteria: Learner builds a quote from a supplied cost sheet showing variable cost per job, price excluding GST, GST statement, break-even jobs per month, and included, excluded and validity lines.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed artefact saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner treats a tax, licence or wastewater point as settled without checking it
